title: Eight cyclic cube fields with ranked proper-run bounds

claims.statement: The explicit eight-field cyclic cube encoder with Golay and Hamming parity and its radius-28, depth-dependent cost list decoder for 1000 message bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 71436044597254891/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=8975170118119937315974152735627083227692388792529065691351361856525 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(111207/500).

experiments.purpose: Check exact full-support occupancy, one sector of proper-run profile classes over all lengths, and (in sector zero) exact admission, field and work inequality.
